title: Model supply entropy index and early warning triggers
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: Background: As open-source and hosted model availability becomes more volatile, procurement and dedicated capacity teams need an automated signal to detect supply instability before customer-facing degradation occurs. Goal: Define and prototype a Model Supply Entropy Index (MSEI) that aggregates discrete signals (availability, quantization compatibility, regional presence, latency variance, price churn, vendor announcements) into a single, actionable score and map thresholds to early-warning triggers and operational playbooks. Scope: initial prototype covering English text-generation models in NA + EU, monthly refresh; integrate into Model Supply Signals dashboard and wire basic alerting to PagerDuty + Slack channel.
acceptance_criteria: MSEI calculated weekly for a 50-model candidate set with documented signal weights
Dashboard widget (supply-sentinel) shows MSEI trend and top contributing factors
Three alert tiers defined with thresholds and triage runbooks linked
Prototype alerting end-to-end (dashboard -> Slack -> oncall) exercised in tabletop
Stakeholder approval from Procurement, Runtime, and Sales Ops obtained
comments: 2026-02-25 Alyssa Chen: Ticket created after weekly model-sourcing sync. Initial hypothesis: combining volatility in price + regional availability with a diversity penalty yields predictive signal for customer disruptions.

2026-03-01 Marcel Ortega: Ran a quick correlation analysis vs historical incidents (internal incident DB). Early signal looks promising: entropy spikes preceded 3/4 provisioning incidents in Q4 2025. Need to validate weighting scheme and avoid overfitting to past outages.
2026-03-04 Priya Raman (Procurement): Reviewed candidate signals. Recommend adding an explicit licensing/contract-change flag pulled from procurement logs and partner newsletters.

2026-03-07 ENG-22331 (runtime) comment: Can expose model availability and quantization support via /internal/model-metadata endpoint; ETA for stable endpoint v0.1 is 2026-03-18. This dependency affects data freshness.

2026-03-10 Marcel Ortega: Drafted scoring prototype (notebook link below) and example thresholds. Shared with runtime and procurement for feedback. Next: convert to a small data pipeline and add dashboard mockups.
2026-03-12 Alyssa Chen: PM review - prioritize alert tier definitions and runbook for Tier 1 before expanding to APAC. Schedule tabletop for 2026-03-18.
notes: Tradeoffs discussed: be conservative with threshold sensitivity to reduce noisy alerts; initial rollouts should use MSEI as advisory (Slack) for 2 cycles before enabling PagerDuty escalations. Consider embargoed model deprecations as additional weighting. Long-term: integrate MSEI into procurement triggers for reserved capacity refreshes.
